short_description: A weighted seated rotation that adds resistance to the oblique twist for greater core strength.
how_to: Sit with your knees bent and heels slightly raised, holding a dumbbell in both hands.
Lean back slightly until your core is engaged.
Rotate the dumbbell to one side, tapping it near the floor.
Rotate to the other side in a controlled motion.
correct: Keep your chest tall throughout.
Keep the dumbbell close to your body.
Move from your torso, not your arms.
Keep a firm grip on the dumbbell.
mistakes: Don't round your back.
Don't use momentum to swing the weight.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't choose a weight that forces you to lose control.

short_description: A gentle supine twist that stretches the obliques and mobilizes the thoracic spine.
how_to: Lie on your back and draw one knee toward your chest.
Guide that knee across your body with the opposite hand.
Extend your other arm out to the side for stability.
Hold the position and breathe steadily, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.
Breathe slowly and steadily.
Relax into the twist gradually.
Keep your neck long and relaxed.
mistakes: Don't force the knee down to the floor.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't let your opposite shoulder lift up.
Don't twist quickly — ease into it.

short_description: A weighted crunch followed by punching movements that works the abs and arms together.
how_to: Lie on your back holding a light dumbbell in each hand.
Crunch your upper back off the floor and hold the position.
From there, punch one arm forward, then the other.
Lower back down with control and repeat.
correct: Keep your lower back controlled.
Keep your core tight during the punches.
Keep your movements deliberate.
Keep your chin off your chest.
mistakes: Don't arch your lower back.
Don't pull on your neck.
Don't swing the dumbbells — punch with control.
Don't choose weights that force your form to break down.

short_description: A lateral isometric hold that strengthens the obliques, glutes and hip abductors.
how_to: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor and elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet or stagger them for balance.
Lift your hips off the floor until your body is straight.
Hold the position, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your hips lifted and level.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to feet.
Keep your core engaged throughout.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't let your hips sag toward the floor.
Don't rotate your torso forward or backward.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't prop your head — keep your neck in line.

short_description: A full-body crunch that lifts both legs and the upper body simultaneously to work the entire core.
how_to: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended overhead.
Keeping your arms and legs straight, lift them both off the floor at once.
Reach your hands toward your feet at the top.
Lower slowly and with control to the starting position.
correct: Keep your lower back controlled.
Keep your legs straight as they rise.
Move with smooth control, not momentum.
Breathe out at the top of the movement.
mistakes: Don't arch your lower back.
Don't pull on your neck.
Don't drop your limbs back down — lower them.
Don't bend your knees to compensate.

short_description: A supine stretch that alternately draws each knee to the chest to release the lower back and hips.
how_to: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Draw one knee toward your chest and hold it with both hands.
Hold gently for a breath, then lower and switch sides.
Alternate at a slow, steady pace.
correct: Keep your opposite leg relaxed on the floor.
Keep your neck and shoulders relaxed.
Breathe steadily throughout.
Hold each side for a full breath before switching.
mistakes: Don't force the knee into your chest.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't lift your head and strain your neck.
Don't rush between sides.

short_description: A seated or supine knee extension on the left leg that strengthens the quadriceps through a controlled range.
how_to: Sit upright on a firm surface with your left knee bent.
Slowly straighten your left leg until it is fully extended.
Hold briefly at the top with your quad engaged.
Lower your foot slowly back to the start.
correct: Keep your thigh still — only your lower leg moves.
Keep the movement slow in both directions.
Keep your back upright and supported.
Breathe steadily throughout.
mistakes: Don't swing the leg up with momentum.
Don't lock the knee aggressively at the top.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't let the foot drop on the way down.

short_description: A side-lying V-up variation that isolates the obliques by folding the body laterally.
how_to: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line.
Place your bottom hand behind your head or on the floor for support.
Lift your legs and upper body toward each other simultaneously.
Lower with control and complete your reps, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your lower back controlled.
Keep the fold lateral — don't rotate forward.
Control the lowering phase.
Breathe out as you lift.
mistakes: Don't arch your lower back.
Don't pull on your neck.
Don't let momentum do the work.
Don't rotate your torso toward the ceiling.

short_description: A shoulder mobility warm-up that circles both arms clockwise to loosen the shoulder joints.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Extend both arms out to your sides.
Swing both arms in large clockwise circles.
Complete your reps, then reverse direction if desired.
correct: Keep your chest open and your posture tall.
Keep the circles large and full-range.
Relax your shoulders as you swing.
Breathe steadily throughout.
mistakes: Don't tense your shoulders up toward your ears.
Don't make the circles too small.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't rush — let each circle be deliberate.

short_description: A reverse lunge that adds a front knee lift at the top to challenge the quads, glutes and balance.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge.
Push through your front heel to stand and drive the rear knee up in front.
Lower the foot back to start and repeat, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down in the lunge.
Keep your chest tall throughout.
Control the knee drive — don't flick.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast.
Don't lean forward as you lunge.
Don't rush the knee drive at the top.
